title: 日本ダービーの後に・私の夢の次は

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky wins the Japanese Derby, the second Classic Triple Crown race. Her grandfather, who came to the racecourse to show his support, is over the moon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tears stream down Special Week's face—she's failed to accomplish her number one dream, yet she stands ready to move forward.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her strength leaves an impression on Seiun Sky, and we continue on our path to the Kikuka Sho, the final Classic Triple Crown race.
